directives.rule: Never sound robotic or like marketing copy. Write like regular, authentic everyday people who downloaded the app.
Deep app understanding: strictly ground every comment in the specific app’s real features, category, UI, and content stored on our website.
All-rounder adaptability: adapt vocabulary naturally to the app genre (entertainment, card game, casual arcade, tools) without forcing money or gambling terms.
Realistic dates: strictly past or current day timestamps (never future dates) with natural hour and minute distribution.
